entities.summary: Csodák Palotája is a science discovery destination in Budapest, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A strongly hands-on science and experiment environment aimed squarely at family participation. This entry is intended for 5–13 travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
entities.whyWorthwhile: A strongly hands-on science and experiment environment aimed squarely at family participation.
